sentences.text:
Civil Application (Caf) No. 2223 Of 2023
 In
 First Appeal (St.) No. 319 Of 2023
 Krushna S/o. Sadashiv Katkadi and others .Vs.

Special Land Acquisition Officer,
 Nagpur and Another
 _______________________________________________________________
Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Coram,
appearances, Court's orders of directions Court's or Judge's orders.
and Registrar's Orders.

Ms Rajkumari Rai, Advocate for the appellants
 Ms Sonia Thakur, Agp for respondent No. 1/State
 Mr. T. M. Zaheer, Advocate for respondent No. 2
 Coram : G.A. Sanap, J.
Date : April 24, 2024.
Heard.
2. This is an application for condonation of 352 days delay caused in filing appeal against impugned judgment and award.
The reasons have been stated in the application.
In view of the reasons, the application is allowed.
3. Delay of 352 days caused in filing appeal stands condoned.

4. It is made clear that in view of the decision in the case of New Okhla Industrial Development Authority Vs. Rameshwar @ Ramesh Chandra Sharma (Dead), through Legal Heir and another (2022 SCC 2 39.caf.2223.2023 Online SC 1599), the original land owners/ claimants/ appellants herein shall not be entitled to get any statutory benefits, including the interest payable under the Land Acquisition Act on the enhanced amount of compensation for the delayed period, in case the appeal is allowed.
